dedupe_keys.name: aeromaps air transport transition scenario model

description: AeroMAPS is an open-source Python model for assessing air-transport transition scenarios. ISAE-SUPAERO publishes its modular code, a teaching interface and documentation for analysing aviation climate effects under different technology and policy levers. Users supply traffic growth, aircraft and fuel assumptions, efficiency changes and scenario years; outputs compare activity, energy use, emissions and other sustainability measures. Its scope is the air-transport sector, not a specific airport, and temporal coverage follows the future scenario. GPL-3.0 source is available through GitHub and PyPI. A limitation is that prospective results depend on assumed fleet turnover, fuel supply and traffic trajectories, not observed future behaviour. AeroMAPS can inform airport, aviation-fuel and transport-system capacity studies. The catalogue's model-aeolus-dutch-aviation-forecast is a distinct Netherlands-focused aviation forecast for comparison; no results were cross-checked. No example scenario or package was run.
inputs: Air traffic, fleet, fuel and policy scenarios
name: AeroMAPS air-transport transition scenario model
